desc: Derive structural characterization: distinct in-degree sequences = distinct c = b+y vectors; c achievable iff ∃ cyclic binary x with per-position relation constraints; subset construction over 2-state x yields a 13-element boolean relation monoid; accepting states = all relations except ∅, {(0,1)}, {(1,0)}.
Write brute-force enumerator + 13-state relation-DP prototype; cross-validate on all strings N ≤ 8, random strings N ≤ 12, and sample 1 (expect 14).

Build the production solver: same 13-state DP but with numpy chunked matrix products (chunk length k=12, lazily memoized chunk-product matrices, int64 with column-split to avoid overflow mod 998244353) to handle N=1e6 in ~1s.
Verify production solver against the validated slow DP on random N≈10³–10⁴ strings, edge patterns (all-zeros/all-ones/alternating), and both samples (14 and 261339902).
Finalize submission: strip verification harness, add fast stdin/stdout main, confirm edge cases (all-zeros, all-ones, N=3), deliver final Python program.
